So our plan right now, we've adopted a net zero by 2050. And we're looking at achieving that through a staged approach. So for 2030, we've recommended, you know, a 10% reduction from our current levels with the full expectation that as we progress through time, obviously there's going to be some strong, you know, governmental changes in terms of federal direction, provincial direction and municipal direction, as well as increase in green technology that will be developed over this period. There's a lot of groups out there that go net zero immediately off the bat and then have a really hard time delivering. So we wanted to, you know, call it under promise and over deliver with respect to the first 10 years and then really go hard in order to ensure that net zero. So we have a number of kind of preliminary targets that we're hoping to achieve, broken out into climate change capacity. We'll also be reviewing some of the municipal policies to ensure that they align with the GHG reduction plan. Beyond that, we're also looking at how we can green our fleet.
